newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia aluminium output slips in Jan 1997 from Dec.
newsitem.headline: Russia aluminium output slips in Jan 1997 from Dec.

text.p: Russian primary aluminium output in January fell two percent from December 1996 levels, but rose two percent from levels in January 1996, State Statistic Committee figures showed on Friday.
The committee, which gave no outright figures, said Russian nickel production in January fell seven percent from the previous month and three percent from year-ago levels.
The committee said January refined copper production fell 11 percent from December levels, but it was six percent higher than year-ago volumes.
Gold production slumped 41 percent in January from the previous month, but was 48 percent higher than January 1996 levels, committee figures showed.
